operations.body:
mutation UpdateNotification($input: UpdateNotificationInput!) {
  updateNotification(input: $input) {
    visitor {
      id
      ...AccountNotifications_Visitor
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
}

fragment AccountNotifications_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  userStatus {
    id
    userFollowerOfMe
    workFollowerOfMyWork
    workCollectionFollowerOfMyWorkCollection
    newEpisodeOfFollowingWork
    completeWorkOfFollowingWork
    newWorkByFollowingUser
    completeWorkByFollowingUser
    newUserNewsEntryByFollowingUser
    newTextualWorkReviewByFollowingUser
    newPointOnlyWorkReviewOfMyWork
    newTextualWorkReviewOfMyWork
    newEpisodeCheerOfMyEpisode
    newEpisodeCommentOfMyEpisode
    newLimitedUserNewsEntryBySponsoringUser
    newUserNewsCommentOfMyUserNewsEntry
    newWorkReviewLikeOfMyWorkReview
    newEpisodeCommentReplyOfMyComment
    newEntryUserEvent
    newRewardAddition
    rankingInAllWeeklyOfMyWork
    rankingInGenreWeeklyOfMyWork
    reservedEpisodePublished
    receiveGift
    newLikeOfMyUserNewsEntry
    receiveUsualNotice
    weeklyFollowingWorkUpdates
    newKakuyomuNextWork
    mediaFranchisedWorkReleaseOfFollowingWork
    __typename
  }
  canReceiveEmailMagazine
  userConfig {
    id
    canReceiveEmailNotification
    canReceiveFolloweeEmailNotification
    canReceiveStepMail
    canReceiveFollowingContentsSpecialEmail
    canReceiveWorkRecommendationMail
    canReceiveNextEmailMagazine
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

operations.body:
query GetAccountNotificationsPage {
  visitor {
    id
    ...AccountPageTemplate_Visitor
    ...AccountNotifications_Visitor
    __typename
  }
}

fragment AccountHeader_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  name
  screenName
  color
  ...HeaderActivityName_User
  ...HeaderTextColorByUserColor_User
  __typename
}

fragment AccountMenu_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  name
  permissions {
    hasAnyActiveSubscription
    canPurchaseGift
    __typename
  }
  giftUser {
    id
    status
    isPurchased
    __typename
  }
  loyaltyUser {
    id
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment AccountNotifications_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  userStatus {
    id
    userFollowerOfMe
    workFollowerOfMyWork
    workCollectionFollowerOfMyWorkCollection
    newEpisodeOfFollowingWork
    completeWorkOfFollowingWork
    newWorkByFollowingUser
    completeWorkByFollowingUser
    newUserNewsEntryByFollowingUser
    newTextualWorkReviewByFollowingUser
    newPointOnlyWorkReviewOfMyWork
    newTextualWorkReviewOfMyWork
    newEpisodeCheerOfMyEpisode
    newEpisodeCommentOfMyEpisode
    newLimitedUserNewsEntryBySponsoringUser
    newUserNewsCommentOfMyUserNewsEntry
    newWorkReviewLikeOfMyWorkReview
    newEpisodeCommentReplyOfMyComment
    newEntryUserEvent
    newRewardAddition
    rankingInAllWeeklyOfMyWork
    rankingInGenreWeeklyOfMyWork
    reservedEpisodePublished
    receiveGift
    newLikeOfMyUserNewsEntry
    receiveUsualNotice
    weeklyFollowingWorkUpdates
    newKakuyomuNextWork
    mediaFranchisedWorkReleaseOfFollowingWork
    __typename
  }
  canReceiveEmailMagazine
  userConfig {
    id
    canReceiveEmailNotification
    canReceiveFolloweeEmailNotification
    canReceiveStepMail
    canReceiveFollowingContentsSpecialEmail
    canReceiveWorkRecommendationMail
    canReceiveNextEmailMagazine
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment AccountPageTemplate_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  ...DefaultTemplate_Visitor
  ...AccountMenu_Visitor
  ...AccountHeader_Visitor
  __typename
}

fragment CompactGlobalHeader on Visitor {
  id
  ...CompactGlobalHeaderNotificationItem_Visitor
  ...CompactGlobalHeaderAccountItem_Visitor
  __typename
}

fragment CompactGlobalHeaderAccountItem_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  screenName
  ...GlobalSidebar_Visitor
  __typename
}

fragment CompactGlobalHeaderNotificationItem_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  unreadNoticesCount
  __typename
}

fragment DefaultTemplate_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  ...Head_Visitor
  ...MediaGlobalHeader_Visitor
  __typename
}

fragment GlobalSidebarMySummary on MonthlyReadingQuantitySummary {
  targetMonth
  readingCharCount
  readingWorkCount
  workReviewCount
  __typename
}

fragment GlobalSidebarUserName on Visitor {
  id
  name
  activityName
  screenName
  penName
  __typename
}

fragment GlobalSidebarUserPageLinks on Visitor {
  id
  name
  __typename
}

fragment GlobalSidebar_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  currentMonthReadingQuantitySummary {
    ...GlobalSidebarMySummary
    __typename
  }
  ...GlobalSidebarUserName
  ...GlobalSidebarUserPageLinks
  __typename
}

fragment Head_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  unreadNoticesCount
  __typename
}

fragment HeaderActivityName_User on User {
  id
  name
  color
  activityName
  ...HeaderTextColorByUserColor_User
  __typename
}

fragment HeaderTextColorByUserColor_User on User {
  id
  color
  __typename
}

fragment MediaGlobalHeader_Visitor on Visitor {
  ...CompactGlobalHeader
  ...RegularGlobalHeader
  __typename
}

fragment RegularGlobalHeader on Visitor {
  id
  ...RegularGlobalHeaderNotificationItem_Visitor
  ...RegularGlobalHeaderUserItem_Visitor
  __typename
}

fragment RegularGlobalHeaderNotificationItem_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  unreadNoticesCount
  __typename
}

fragment RegularGlobalHeaderUserItem_Visitor on Visitor {
  id
  name
  screenName
  ...RegularGlobalHeaderUserMenu
  __typename
}

fragment RegularGlobalHeaderUserMenu on Visitor {
  id
  name
  activityName
  screenName
  penName
  __typename
}
